description: Original bounded algebra algorithm with independent finite checks
cost: Ascending coefficient polynomials over prime998244353. P=low*low + x^m((low+high)*(low+high)-low*low-high*high)+x^(2m)high*high. Pad power2 and trim to a.len+b.len-1; empty gives empty; lengths<=4096. O(n^log2(3)) time O(n) live memory. Karatsuba and Ofman, Multiplication of many-digital numbers by automatic computers (1962).
forward: Ascending coefficient polynomials over prime998244353. P=low*low + x^m((low+high)*(low+high)-low*low-high*high)+x^(2m)high*high. Pad power2 and trim to a.len+b.len-1; empty gives empty; lengths<=4096. O(n^log2(3)) time O(n) live memory. Karatsuba and Ofman, Multiplication of many-digital numbers by automatic computers (1962).
inverse: Accepted nonempty pair excludes outputs with length other than len(a)+len(b)-1 or coefficient not congruent to sum a[i]b[k-i]. Zero trailing coefficients must remain. Over-cap lengths exclude Ok even with empty partner.

Observed product admits all factor pairs over the fixed field matching coefficient length. Scaling a by nonzero c and b by c^-1 preserves product; zero products and empty outputs are particularly nonunique. Inputs are also ambiguous modulo p.
limitations: Partial syntax; finite tests do not prove universal correctness; no allocator failure injection; no executable surrogate
